ios.desc:
Bulletin is a modern RSS news reader with summaries built in, so you can get through everything you follow in less time.
You choose every source, and no algorithm decides what surfaces.
Use the summary to decide what to read, then open the article in a distraction-free reader with no ads.

SMART SUMMARY, POWERED BY REAL ARTICLE CONTENT

Bulletin extracts the article before building its summary, rather than relying on the short text in an RSS feed. The result reflects what the article actually says, so you're not judging a story by its headline.

• Read a concise summary in bullet points or one sentence
• Switch to Quotes mode to read the article's key quotes, word for word
• Improve unclear or clickbait headlines with a clearer, more accurate one
• Summarise a whole feed or category, with each point citing the publication behind it. Tap to open the story
• Copy, select, or share summaries

Bulletin uses AI to summarise article content.

YOU PICK EVERY SOURCE

Start reading straight away with useful starter categories, then make Bulletin yours. Add the publications, independent writers, blogs, and specialist sites you trust. Nothing is inserted because an algorithm thinks it should be there.

• Add an RSS feed from any supported site or feed URL
• Import an existing collection with OPML, or export it when you need to
• Create, rename, hide, and organise categories around the way you follow news
• Enable, disable, or rename individual sources at any time
• Mute phrases you do not want to see in your feeds

A FOR YOU FEED, ON YOUR TERMS

For You brings your chosen categories together in one personalised feed. Nothing is ranked or promoted: it is all from sources you added.

Sort a combined feed purely by time and the sites that post twenty times a day bury the ones that post twice a week. Weaved mode keeps For You close to newest first, but never lets one source run more than twice before another gets a turn. Busy sites still appear as often, just spread out, so everything you follow gets seen.

• Weaved mode, so no single source takes over the feed
• Switch to chronological ordering whenever you prefer
• Choose which categories appear together in For You

READ THE WAY YOU WANT

A summary is a starting point. When an article deserves your attention, open it in a clean reading view that keeps the text and images while removing page ads and newsletter prompts. You can also switch to the original page at any time.
